column1: Table S5. Principal non-redundant HSF motif-coordinate placements and strict overlap-merged HSF regions in the native and in-silico-designed HSE-disrupted 49-bp sequences and Col-0 ONSEN terminal candidate windows.

HSF-family predictions were filtered at relative PWM score ≥0.85. The principal metric maps all predictions to physical forward-sequence coordinates, then collapses duplicate PWM-model/strand predictions with identical 1-based start-end coordinates. The strict sensitivity metric merges HSF intervals transitively when they overlap by ≥1 nt. Both metrics represent computational motif compatibility, not experimentally verified HSF occupancy.
